:::{#thm-mutual-information-reduction}
#### Mutual information as a reduction in entropy

For [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ and $Y$
with finite [entropies](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy),
the [mutual information](#def-mutual-information) is the reduction in the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) of either variable
from learning the other:

$$I(X; Y) = \entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X} = \entropyf{X} - \entropyf{X \mid Y}.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

Subtract $\entropyf{X}$ from both sides of the [chain rule](#thm-entropy-chain-rule):

$$\entropyf{Y \mid X} = \entropyf{X, Y} - \entropyf{X}.$$

Substituting into @def-mutual-information gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X}
&= \entropyf{Y} - \sb{\entropyf{X, Y} - \entropyf{X}} \\
&= \entropyf{X} + \entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{X, Y} \\
&= I(X; Y).
\end{aligned}
$$

The [chain rule](#thm-entropy-chain-rule) also gives $\entropyf{X \mid Y} = \entropyf{X, Y} - \entropyf{Y}$,
so the same steps <!-- check-term-links: allow --> with $X$ and $Y$ exchanged
give $\entropyf{X} - \entropyf{X \mid Y} = I(X; Y)$.

:::
